attr.title: Ruffle Handheld
attr.desc: Offline Flash integration for ARM64 Linux handhelds, with frozen v0.7.7 binaries, profile-controlled buttons and a visual offline profile maker.
attr.inst: One universal launcher and one application folder. On EmuELEC place the .sh in ports_scripts and rufflehandheld in ports; on other CFWs use their normal Ports location. The same launcher detects the CFW and locates the application without downloading anything.
